en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Al Husayn Bin Abdullah Al Sagheer, from Muhammad Bin Ibrahim Al Ja’fary, from Ahmad Bin Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Abdullah Bin Umar, 
(It has been narrated) son of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup>, from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Existed when there was no other existence. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the existence (beings), and the space, and Created the Light of the light from which the lights are illuminated, and Made to flow into it from His<sup>azwj</sup> Own Light from which the lights lit up, and it is the Light from which were created Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and Ali<sup>asws</sup>. So they<sup>asws</sup> did not cease to be two former lights when there was nothing existing before the two of them<sup>asws</sup>. Thus, they both<sup>asws</sup> did not cease to flow as clean, having been Cleaned, into the clean ‘الْأَصْلَابِ’, until they both<sup>asws</sup> separated in the most clean of the two clean (linages), in Abdullah<sup>as</sup> and Abu Talib<sup>as</sup>’.
